programs.name: 每日灵修｜2分钟读经与祷告 · 早间
programs.desc: 一天的开始：一节经文、一段讲解、一句祷告，先被鼓励，再去忙碌。

episodes.title: 我的恩典够你用的
episodes.theme: 主没有挪开保罗的刺，却给了更好的回答：带着刺也能服事，软弱不是障碍，恰恰是恩典显出来的地方。

episodes.title: 我必用我公义的右手扶持你
episodes.theme: 神连着说了三个「我必」：必坚固、必帮助、必扶持——先有同在，后面的帮助才有着落，周末把心放回祂手里。

episodes.title: 你当刚强壮胆
episodes.theme: 刚强壮胆的底气不是「我有把握」，而是「祂与我同在」：胆量不是等害怕消失，而是在路上长出来的。

episodes.title: 这是耶和华所定的日子
episodes.theme: 今天不是随机抽到的一天：先把欢喜定在神的手里，外面的事只能排第二，带着一件谢恩的小事出门。

episodes.title: 靠着那加给我力量的
episodes.theme: 力量的来源不在自己身上：保罗在监狱里学到的知足，是把「我能」换成「靠着祂，我能」，出门前先领今天够用的口粮。

episodes.title: 那等候耶和华的必重新得力
episodes.theme: 等候中更新：等候不是干坐着，是望着神存着盼望，力气耗干处重新得力。

episodes.title: 你要专心仰赖耶和华
episodes.theme: 不靠自己的聪明：新一周的事先交托，在所行的事上认定祂，祂必指引路。

episodes.title: 你们不可停止聚会
episodes.theme: 主日与团契：一个人像一根柴单独烧，聚在一处，火才重新旺起来。

episodes.title: 凡劳苦担重担的人，可以到我这里来
episodes.theme: 把重担卸下：安息不是把事办漂亮了才配得，是先到祂面前才得着。

episodes.title: 你们要休息，要知道我是神
episodes.theme: 在忙乱里停下来：把手松开、先安静，认清祂是神，再开始这一天。

episodes.title: 祂为我们的罪作了挽回祭
episodes.theme: 挽回祭与破碎：我们所传的是除去世人罪孽的神的羔羊；人身上破碎之处，正是祂动工之处。

programs.name: Daily Devotion｜2-Minute Bible & Prayer · 早间（英语版）
programs.desc: Daily Devotion, morning edition in English: one verse, a short reflection, and a prayer to start the day. First translation, pending native-speaker proofreading. 初译待母语校对。

episodes.title: Thoughts of Peace
episodes.theme: His thoughts toward you are peace, not harm — even in Babylon, He is quietly burying hope for your future.

episodes.title: Be Strong and Courageous
episodes.theme: Courage is not the absence of fear; it grows along the road, because He is with us.

episodes.title: This Is the Day the Lord Has Made
episodes.theme: Settle your joy in God's hands first; the day's events can only come second.

episodes.title: Through Him Who Strengthens Me
episodes.theme: Swap 'I can' for 'through Him, I can'; strength is daily provision, not a bonus.

episodes.title: Those Who Wait Shall Renew Their Strength
episodes.theme: Waiting is not idleness; strength is renewed, like an eagle soaring on the wind.

episodes.title: Trust in the Lord with All Your Heart
episodes.theme: Lay the week's decisions before God first; acknowledge Him, and He will make the path straight.

episodes.title: Do Not Give Up Meeting Together
episodes.theme: A lone stick of firewood burns low; together, the fire grows strong again.

episodes.title: Come to Me, All You Who Labor
episodes.theme: Rest is not earned by getting everything done first; it is received when we come to Him first.

programs.name: Devoción Diaria｜Biblia y Oración · 早间（西语版）
programs.desc: Daily Devotion, morning edition in Spanish: one verse, a short reflection, and a prayer to start the day. First translation, pending native-speaker proofreading. 初译待母语校对。

episodes.title: Pensamientos de paz
episodes.theme: Sus pensamientos hacia ti son de paz y no de mal; aun en Babilonia, él siembra la esperanza de tu futuro.

episodes.title: Esfuérzate y sé valiente
episodes.theme: El valor no es no tener miedo; es dar el paso porque él está contigo.

episodes.title: Este es el día que hizo Jehová
episodes.theme: Decide tu gozo antes de salir de casa, y lo demás solo podrá ir en segundo lugar.

episodes.title: Todo lo puedo en Cristo que me fortalece
episodes.theme: Cambia el «yo puedo» por «en Cristo puedo»: la fuerza es la ración de cada día.

episodes.title: Los que esperan a Jehová tendrán nuevas fuerzas
episodes.theme: Esperar no es no hacer nada: es mirar a Dios, y en la espera la fuerza se renueva.

episodes.title: Fíate de Jehová de todo tu corazón
episodes.theme: No te apoyes en tus propios cálculos: ponlo primero ante Dios, y él enderezará tus veredas.

episodes.title: No dejando nuestra congregación
episodes.theme: Un tizón solo se apaga; reunidos, el fuego se aviva y nos edificamos unos a otros.

episodes.title: Venid a mí todos los que estáis trabajados
episodes.theme: El descanso no se gana terminando todo primero; se recibe al venir primero a él.

programs.name: Tĩnh Nguyện Hằng Ngày｜2 Phút Đọc Kinh Thánh & Cầu Nguyện · 早间（越南语版）
programs.desc: Daily Devotion, morning edition in Vietnamese: one verse, a short reflection, and a prayer to start the day. First translation, pending native-speaker proofreading. 初译待母语校对。

episodes.title: Hãy Đến Cùng Ta, Hỡi Những Kẻ Mệt Mỏi
episodes.theme: Sự yên nghỉ không phải là phần thưởng sau khi làm xong mọi việc; ta nhận được nó khi đến với Chúa trước tiên.

programs.name: दैनिक भक्ति｜2 मिनट बाइबल और प्रार्थना · 早间（印地语版）
programs.desc: Daily Devotion, morning edition in Hindi: one verse, a short reflection, and a prayer to start the day. First translation, pending native-speaker proofreading. 初译待母语校对。

episodes.title: मेरे पास आओ, सब परिश्रम करने वालों
episodes.theme: विश्राम सब कुछ पूरा कर लेने का इनाम नहीं है; वह प्रभु के पास पहले आने पर मिलता है।

programs.name: 每日灵修｜2分钟读经与祷告 · 睡前
programs.desc: 一天的收尾：安息的经文与晚祷，慢下来，把这一天交在神手里，好好入睡。

episodes.title: 将一切的忧虑卸给神
episodes.theme: 卸包袱式的交托：因为祂顾念我们，忧虑一件一件说给祂听、真的放下，换一双更稳的手接着。

episodes.title: 住在至高者隐密处的
episodes.theme: 隐密处不是临时躲避的防空洞，而是平日住下的地方：把最放心不下的事连同自己，一起搬进祂的荫下。

episodes.title: 我留下平安给你们
episodes.theme: 主的平安不像世人所赐的：环境还没变，心先安了；把这一周的好与坏都放下，别让它们跟着上床。

episodes.title: 祂叫所亲爱的安然睡觉
episodes.theme: 睡觉是神给所亲爱之人的礼物：你先睡，祂不睡；你歇手，祂的手没有歇，没做完的留给明天的功课。

episodes.title: 祂亲自同去，使你得安息
episodes.theme: 安息不是到了目的地才有：明天那段路祂亲自同行，今晚先把脚步停下来，让祂走在前头。

episodes.title: 夜里思想祂的话
episodes.theme: 在床上记念祢：在旷野的夜里思想神的话，心像饱足了骨髓肥油。

episodes.title: 睡前数算今天的恩典
episodes.theme: 每早晨都是新的：睡前数算今天的恩典——祂的怜悯不断绝，诚实极其广大。

episodes.title: 夜里的歌
episodes.theme: 白昼施慈爱，黑夜有歌声：离家发愁的人，数算的不是眼泪，是祂的慈爱。

episodes.title: 祂守夜，我安睡
episodes.theme: 保护你的必不打盹：祂守夜，我们安睡；走远路的人夜里也不孤单。

episodes.title: 放下今天，平安入睡
episodes.theme: 我必安然躺下睡觉：让人睡不着的事先算清楚，独有耶和华使我安然居住。

programs.name: Daily Devotion｜2-Minute Bible & Prayer · 睡前（英语版）
programs.desc: Daily Devotion, bedtime edition in English: a verse of rest and a closing prayer. First translation, pending native-speaker proofreading. 初译待母语校对。

episodes.title: My Peace I Give to You
episodes.theme: His peace is given before circumstances change; lay the week down at His feet tonight.

episodes.title: He Gives Sleep to His Loved Ones
episodes.theme: Sleep is a gift; loosen the day's taut string before your head reaches the pillow.

episodes.title: My Presence Will Go with You
episodes.theme: Rest does not wait for the destination; it comes because He travels the road with us.

episodes.title: I Remember You on My Bed
episodes.theme: One verse held in the heart at night feeds more than ten that slide past.

episodes.title: Great Is Your Faithfulness
episodes.theme: Count three small mercies before sleep, and the heart settles.

episodes.title: His Song in the Night
episodes.theme: By day we sing because we see grace; at night we sing because we believe grace is still there.

episodes.title: He Who Keeps You Will Not Slumber
episodes.theme: We can sleep in peace, because He stays awake all night.

programs.name: Devoción Diaria｜Biblia y Oración · 睡前（西语版）
programs.desc: Daily Devotion, bedtime edition in Spanish: a verse of rest, a short reflection, and an evening prayer. First translation, pending native-speaker proofreading. 初译待母语校对。

episodes.title: La paz os dejo
episodes.theme: Su paz se da antes de que cambie el ambiente: recíbela esta noche y duerme tranquilo.

episodes.title: A su amado dará Dios el sueño
episodes.theme: Dormir en paz es un regalo para sus amados: afloja la cuerda; lo demás es tarea de mañana.

episodes.title: Mi presencia irá contigo
episodes.theme: El descanso no espera a llegar al destino: su presencia va contigo en todo el camino.

episodes.title: Cuando me acordaré de ti en mi lecho
episodes.theme: Una sola frase de su palabra, saboreada en la noche, alimenta más que diez que pasan de largo.

episodes.title: Nuevas son cada mañana
episodes.theme: Antes de dormir, cuenta tres misericordias de hoy: su fidelidad no se interrumpió ni un momento.

episodes.title: De noche su canción será conmigo
episodes.theme: De día su misericordia, de noche su canción: aunque oscurezca, él sigue ahí.

episodes.title: No se dormirá el que te guarda
episodes.theme: Tú duermes; el que te guarda no se adormece ni duerme. Esta noche puedes soltarlo todo.

episodes.theme: Đêm nay ta có thể yên tâm ngủ, vì Đấng canh giữ ta thức trọn cả đêm không hề buồn ngủ.

episodes.theme: हम शांति से सो सकते हैं, क्योंकि हमारा रक्षक पूरी रात जागता है।

programs.name: 瓦器分享｜圣经讲解与讲道
programs.desc: 圣经原文解经讲道：开场祷告、三大部分讲论、交叉经文与应用。

episodes.title: 祢却为我建立家室
episodes.theme: 大卫想为神建一座有期限的殿，神却翻转说「我必为你建立家室」——人的心愿有期限，神的应许直到永远；领受应许的人，只管抱住神的话，求祂照所说的而行。

episodes.title: 第七日的安息
episodes.theme: 从原文词义讲神为什么安息、安息日的设立，以及安息如何进到我们今天的生活。

episodes.title: 天国的颠覆性生命
episodes.theme: 哀恸的人与温柔的人：天国的生命逻辑与世界相反，柔和谦卑里藏着承受地土的福。
